title: Five Tips Five Separate Slides
tests: Tests one-to-one mapping of five supplied tips to five ordered slides without adding cover or closing slides.

faults.what: All five slides use black or dark gray on white rather than the explicitly requested blue-and-white palette.
Typography, numeral sizes, and spacing vary substantially between slides, weakening carousel consistency; the number 5 is particularly oversized.

judge.summary: Five correctly ordered, readable, illustrated slides were delivered, but the requested blue-and-white palette is missing and the typography is inconsistent.

must_haves.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images are delivered, with no extra cover or closing slide.
must_haves.why: Five separate 4:5 portrait images are shown, with no additional slides.

must_haves.item: The five supplied tips appear verbatim, one per slide, in the requested order.
must_haves.why: Each supplied tip appears exactly once on its corresponding slide in the correct order.

must_haves.item: The slides are visibly numbered 1 through 5 in sequence.
must_haves.why: Each slide has a clearly visible number, running from 1 to 5.

must_haves.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its specific tip.
must_haves.why: The slides show a desk, a silenced phone, a checked box, a timer, and a person stretching beside a desk.

must_haves.item: All slides share a clean blue-and-white visual design with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: The text is readable and unclipped and the layouts are minimal, but there is no visible blue in the design.
